title: HeroesSMP Utilities
description: This is a utility mod adding features such as being able to tame everything, new liquids, ect. This was made for use on the HeroesSMP server.
body:
This is a mod to act as a library or utility for those developing on my HeroesSMP server. Anyone is free to use it, it currently does not require _Palladium_ but likely will do so in the future.

Currently included:

- Acetone (Fluid that transforms into air)
- Liquid Cement (Fluid that transforms into gray concrete)
- Liquid Honey (Slows players down and can be bottled)
  
- "Transmutation blocks" that almost immediately change into one of the 5 liquids__
  
- The ability to tame any animal or creature through the </tame (mob) (player)> command
